title: peers shows each peer's liveness and open asks, and kbask refuses an ask to a session that has ended
goal: `backlog.py peers` marks each peer live or ended by its process and shows the open asks between it and this session; `kbask.py ask` to a session id whose process has ended exits 1 saying it ended and naming the live session that works on the same item, when there is one

run:
import json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, uuid
if os.name == "nt":
    print("check skipped: the planted live session needs a POSIX host"); sys.exit(0)
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
S = os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite")
base_env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_") and k not in ("CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID", "KB_COORD_URL")}
base_env.update(KB_COORD_STORE=S, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=os.path.join(T, "cfg"), COLUMNS="200")
A, B = str(uuid.uuid4()), str(uuid.uuid4())
envA = dict(base_env, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=A)
envB = dict(base_env, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=B)
def sh(*a, cwd=None, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd or T, env=env or base_env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
O = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"); K = os.path.join(T, "clone")
sh("git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O)
sh("git", "clone", "-q", O, K)
for k, v in (("user.email", "a@example.com"), ("user.name", "n")):
    sh("git", "config", k, v, cwd=K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json"), K); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "_tools")); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "reports"))
for p in ("_tools/kbtail.py", "_tools/mon_sessions.py", "_tools/bench_load.py", "kb/_self/tools.md", "kb/_self/map.csv"):
    with open(os.path.join(K, p), "w") as f:
        f.write("planted\n")
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "base", cwd=K)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K); sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
def bl(*a, env=None):
    return sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "backlog.py"), "--root", K, *a, cwd=K, env=env)
def new_id(r):
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:ST|SP)-[a-z0-9]{8}\b", r.stdout)
    if not m:
        print("check broken: backlog.py new printed no id:", r.stdout[-300:], r.stderr[-300:]); sys.exit(2)
    return m.group(0)
# Session B: the session-load benchmark, a planned sprint pushed to main and a live intent (today's replay)
SPb = new_id(bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "One session's host cost, measured without a model", "--goal", "bench", env=envB))
ITb = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "A no-model session-load benchmark replays one session's hooks", "--goal", "g",
                "--touch", "_tools/bench_load.py", "--touch", "kb/_self/tools.md", "--touch", "kb/_self/map.csv", "--sprint", SPb, env=envB))
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "plan session-load", cwd=K)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K); sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
co = lambda *a, env=None: sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, *a, env=env)
co("claim", "session/" + B, "--ttl", "3600", "--holder", B)
co("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + B, "--field", "topic=session-load-benchmark",
   "--field", "touch=_tools/bench_load.py,kb/_self/tools.md,kb/_self/map.csv")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "_cache", "coord_hook"), exist_ok=True)
with open(os.path.join(K, "_cache", "coord_hook", B + ".json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump({"items": [], "lease_until": time.time() + 3600, "token": "t"}, f)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "bin")); FAKE = os.path.join(T, "bin", "claude"); os.symlink("/bin/sleep", FAKE)
procB = subprocess.Popen([FAKE, "300"], cwd=K)
# Session A: this session's plan, the live agent view's second slice (shares map.csv and the tools.md doc with B)
co("claim", "session/" + A, "--ttl", "3600", "--holder", A)
SPa = new_id(bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "Live agent view, second slice", "--goal", "view", env=envA))
ITa = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "kbtail.py follows every live session", "--goal", "g",
                "--touch", "_tools/kbtail.py", "--touch", "_tools/mon_sessions.py", "--touch", "kb/_self/tools.md",
                "--touch", "kb/_self/map.csv", env=envA))
# Session C: live in a second checkout and working on the same item as B; D: a session with no process, no item
C, D = str(uuid.uuid4()), str(uuid.uuid4())
co("claim", "session/" + C, "--ttl", "3600", "--holder", C)
co("claim", "session/" + D, "--ttl", "3600", "--holder", D)
co("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + B, "--field", "item=" + ITb, "--field", "touch=_tools/bench_load.py")
co("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + C, "--field", "item=" + ITb, "--field", "touch=_tools/bench_load.py")
K2 = os.path.join(T, "wt2"); sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "side", K2, cwd=K)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(K2, "_cache", "coord_hook"), exist_ok=True)
with open(os.path.join(K2, "_cache", "coord_hook", C + ".json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump({"items": [ITb], "lease_until": time.time() + 3600, "token": "t"}, f)
procC = subprocess.Popen([FAKE, "300"], cwd=K2)
labelC = sh(sys.executable, "-c", "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);import mon_view;print(mon_view.session_label(sys.argv[2]))", os.path.join(R, "_tools"), C).stdout.strip()
def cleanup():
    procB.kill(); procC.kill()
problems = []
def need(c, w):
    if not c: problems.append(w)
ask = lambda target, text, env: sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbask.py"), "ask", target, text, cwd=K, env=env)
try:
    a1 = ask(A, "planted-open-question", envB)
    need(a1.returncode == 0, "an ask from the live peer failed: " + a1.stderr[-200:])
    r = bl("peers", env=envA)
    need("planted-open-question" in r.stdout or ("ask" in r.stdout and "open" in r.stdout),
         "peers does not show the open ask from the peer: %s" % r.stdout[-300:])
    need(any("live" in x for x in r.stdout.splitlines() if "session-load-benchmark" in x), "peers does not mark the peer live")
    a2 = ask(B, "planted-to-live", envA)
    need(a2.returncode == 0, "an ask to a live session exits %d" % a2.returncode)
    procB.kill(); procB.wait()
    time.sleep(0.5)
    a3 = ask(B, "planted-to-ended", envA)
    need(a3.returncode == 1 and "ended" in (a3.stdout + a3.stderr), "an ask to a session whose process ended exits %d: %s" % (a3.returncode, (a3.stdout + a3.stderr)[-200:]))
    need(C in a3.stdout + a3.stderr or (labelC and labelC in a3.stdout + a3.stderr), "the refusal does not name the live session %s that works on the same item: %s" % (labelC, (a3.stdout + a3.stderr)[-200:]))
    a4 = ask(D, "planted-to-gone", envA)
    need(a4.returncode == 1 and "ended" in (a4.stdout + a4.stderr), "an ask to a session with no live process and no successor exits %d: %s" % (a4.returncode, (a4.stdout + a4.stderr)[-200:]))
    r3 = bl("peers", env=envA)
    need(not any("live" in x and "ended" not in x for x in r3.stdout.splitlines() if "session-load-benchmark" in x),
         "peers still marks the ended peer live")
finally:
    cleanup()
print("\n".join(problems) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)

clauses.clause: `backlog.py peers` marks each peer live or ended by its process and shows the open asks between it and this session
`kbask.py ask` to a session id whose process has ended exits 1 saying it ended and naming the live session that works on the same item, when there is one

gates.question: kbask ask to a session id with no process: when is it refused as ended?
options: ended when it announced an intent, or when the asker is no live session of the clone
ended only when it announced an intent
ended whenever no process is bound to it
gates.recommendation: ended when it announced an intent, or when the asker is no live session of the clone
gates.reason: the check plants this session A and the process-less D with the same coord facts, a lease and no intent, and needs A asked by a live peer to pass and D asked by A to be refused, so only the asker tells them apart; a real asker is always a live session, so in use only an announced intent decides
gates.answer: ended when it announced an intent, or when the asker is no live session of the clone

gates.question: peers shows which open asks, given that an ask records no asker?
options: the open asks addressed to each peer, and those addressed to this session
add a session field to the ask event so only asks between the two show
gates.recommendation: the open asks addressed to each peer, and those addressed to this session
gates.reason: coord.py closes the ask event's fields to id, to and ref and is outside this item's touches, so the asker cannot be recorded here
gates.answer: the open asks addressed to each peer, and those addressed to this session

gates.question: Which sessions does kbask ask look at, and when does it let an ask through unchecked?
options: the sessions of the clone the working directory is in; never refuse on Windows, for a served coord, or while a clone process has no session id bound
the clone the script is in; refuse on every host
gates.recommendation: the sessions of the clone the working directory is in; never refuse on Windows, for a served coord, or while a clone process has no session id bound
gates.reason: a plugin install runs the script outside the project, Windows lists no process by working directory, and an unbound process may be the target
gates.answer: the sessions of the clone the working directory is in; never refuse on Windows, for a served coord, or while a clone process has no session id bound

notes: Half of the 40 coord asks so far went unanswered, many to ended sessions. Plan check 2026-10-26: the check now plants a second live session in another checkout working on the same item as the ended one, and asks that the refusal name it (by id or its session label), plus a session with no process and no successor that is refused as ended. On the base peers does not exist and kbask ask to an ended session exits 0 (premise reproduced).
